svg.title: Six independent measurements versus known target precision
svg.desc: Six independent results from one Normal population have concentration values 9.8,9.9,9.9,10.1,10.1,10.2 mg/L. The sample variance is 0.024 squared mg/L. A fixed known target SD is 0.10 mg/L, not estimated from a second sample.

g.text: Compare variance with a fixed target
Dot positions are conceptual; numeric results are reported separately
